Native features/base coefficients/history table fixed; no identities as model inputs. True parent public replay features are the same representation the belief prior uses per hypothesis, not an information-set-realizable opponent policy. Fresh chronological fit splits relative to old Nov2 predictors; late evaluation may overlap previously curated taxonomy, so not pristine prospective confirmation.
